5.2.2 String Type
VSS is unicode encoded but leaves open if UTF-8 or UTF-16 is utilized.
[AP_TR_VSS_02003] VSS Primitive String Type
Status: DRAFT
⌈The VSS Importer shall create UTF-8 encoded Strings. The encoding is not mod-
elled. UTF-16 is currently unsupported.⌋
